title: 335 prove Guava signed means over both entire primitive domains
description: Check the released IntMath.mean and LongMath.mean on all signed input pairs, together with the deliberately overflow-prone control. The 65-bit reference includes the carry from bit 63, and the external boundary check uses BigInteger.
expected: Every frozen obligation meets its expectation, with a real independent JVM witness for each refutation.

steps.name: Check the original bytecode and observers
